title: Implementing eHealth Interventions Into Regular Clinical Practice
brief_summary: The purpose with this study is to test a digital patient-provider communication tool for symptom and needs management among patients with chronic health conditions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Non functioning pituitary adenomas (NFPA)
* Able to read and speak Norwegian
* Have access to a Smart-phone or tablet
* Have their own secure access device (BankID).

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
